_comment: Generic goals a human might type to Claude Code, each with the endpoint(s) and/or skill(s) `devrev-find` must put in its top 3. Run: python3 -I scripts/eval_finder.py. Add a case whenever a real request finds the wrong thing; fix the synonyms, not the case. `expect_*` lists are alternatives: any one in the top 3 counts as a hit.
